review.subject: Repair of T2 per R2 findings: F1 self-broadcast (both spellings), N1 durable wake, N2 fold problems, N3 AC-8 arm
review.sandwich: All hashes above were IDENTICAL at gate start (11:06:19Z) and review end. ATTRIBUTION: mailbox-store.ts also contains T17's later hunk (workspace-wide reference resolution, mtime 19:02); that hunk is T19's lane and my probes are indifferent to it. The cellwork dist delta is T18's in-flight package (cellwork inlines team-core) — not charged here.

verdict.justification: All four R2 findings are closed and I proved the N2 concern the captain flagged — the optional `problems` field cannot hide an anomaly: `fold`/`readMailbox` always populate it, a clean log yields a PRESENT empty list, every tolerated anomaly (duplicate id, unresolved replyTo, rootless threadId) is surfaced through the wrapper AND carried through `scopeToTeam` into the web projection, and the stamps follow first-wins with the content. F1's both-spellings self rule, the durable wake line with its mandatory reason, and the completed AC-8 arm are all live (459/0). One non-blocking residual Nit: no TEAM-plane surface renders the wake outcome yet.

findingsAudit.finding: F1 (R2 Medium) — a MEMBER's `*` broadcast included its own roster row, and a member could message its own roster id
findingsAudit.evidence: Store: `senderIds` = {fromId, fromMemberId}; the per-target check refuses `self` for EITHER spelling (probe F1a: by roster id AND by session id → reason 'self'). Tool: `selfId: ownMember?.id ?? callerId` (probe F1b vs F1c: roster-id selfId excludes M1; the OLD session-id shape would include it). End-to-end tool arm 'a MEMBER's `*` excludes its OWN roster row, and a member cannot message itself' passes and asserts messages = [Reviewer, captain], plus the direct self-send refusal. My fan-out probe writes rows [M2, lead-session] — no self row.

findingsAudit.finding: N1 (R2 Nit) — a wake failure was only a process log line
findingsAudit.evidence: `recordWake` appends a durable `MailWakeLine` with a TYPE-required reason when sent:false; probe N1 shows the line as the last record with reason 'the Lead has no executor handle', the success case carries no reason, and the mailbox fold ignores the foreign record (1 message, problems []). The tool arm writes TWO wake lines for a fan-out (one sent:true, one sent:false with 'recorded, not woken').

findingsAudit.finding: N2 (R2 Nit) — the team wrapper dropped the protocol fold's problems (a duplicate id was invisible)
findingsAudit.evidence: Probes: clean log → `problems` PRESENT and [] ; duplicate id → messages keep the FIRST subject/stamps AND problems names the duplicate; `scopeToTeam` carries the same list; the web projection surfaces it (`buildTeamMail(ws).problems` non-empty); unresolved `replyTo` and a rootless explicit `threadId` both surface through the wrapper. The shipped arms assert a duplicate, the clean-`[]`, and `scopeToTeam(...).problems === state.problems`. Optionality is harmless: `fold`/`readMailbox` always set it, and the only caller-built state (the wait path) is not a fold result.

findingsAudit.finding: N3 (R2 Nit) — AC-8's arm asserted only 3 of the 5 envelope fields
findingsAudit.evidence: The team-web arm now asserts kind, threadId, replyTo, question.questionId/options, answer.selected AND readBy on a real answer row, and `problems` = [] — probe AC-8 reproduces all five fields plus readBy and a present empty problem list.

findings.title: The durable wake outcome is not rendered by any TEAM-plane surface yet (only the raw log and the cell view read it)
findings.what: `recordWake` writes the line and the cellview fold reads `wake` rows for CELL rows, but the team mail tool's summary/unread and the web mail projection do not expose wakeSent/wakeReason. An operator diagnoses a failed wake by reading the JSONL (or `grep`), not from a tool answer.
findings.why: R2's direction was 'write a durable wake outcome (reason) beside the row', which is now true; surfacing it on a team-plane view would close the diagnosis loop for the LEAD case (the one this repository hits most), but is not required by the accepted fix.
findings.direction: Optional follow-up: include per-message wake state in the summary rows or the web projection. Non-blocking.
findings.evidence: probes.ts N1 lines; no team-plane renderer currently reads MailWakeLine
